snippet.title: Inventor's Cabin Announcement
snippet.description: Start in a humble cabin with nothing but tools and a vision. In Inventor's Cabin, you are an engineer aiming to conquer the world. Design engines from scratch, build prototypes by hand, and evolve your workshop into a massive automated factory. Create your own car company and dominate the global automotive industry in this immersive top-down simulation.
